name: StylPro Facial Steamer
short_description:
Encouraging you to indulge in a much-needed moment of self-care, STYLPRO’s Facial Steamer is a multi-tasking device for both the face and home. The innovative steamer utilises a lightweight ionic mist, seeking to permeate into the skin’s pores and rejuvenate the complexion.
\n
\nEasy-to-use, the device boasts four, built-in functions. Unwind as the device sets to work to diffuse aromatherapy oils, or treat yourself to a luxurious facial steam. Additionally, discover the device’s heat towels function, or humidify your home with ease. Just add water, turn the dial to the desired function and let the device do the work.
description:
Benefits: \n \nTo STEAM, rotate the dial to Facial Steamer mode. Wait for the light near the switch to turn blue. Steam will be released after approximately 1 minute. Check the steam temperature 25cm away from the Steamer using your hand. Move your face into the steam flow. Keep your face 25cm away from the nozzle. Direct the steam towards the top of your chin. \n \nTo HEAT FACE TOWELS, rotate the dial anti-clockwise to the Unlock position and remove the head of the steamer. Fold a damp, cotton towel into the Steamer. Put the Steamer head back on in the Locked position. Plug the Steamer in and rotate dial to Towel Warmer mode. Leave for 2 minutes to warm. Unlock the Steamer and lift the towel out with tongs or tweezers. Wait until the towel is manageably warm to apply to the face. \n \nFor AROMATHERAPY DIFFUSION, add a few drops of essential oils into the measuring cup. Place the cup into the Steamer. Replace the Steamer head and rotate to Locked mode. Wait for the light to turn blue. Steam will be released after 1 minute. Keep 25cm away from the nozzle. \n \nTo HUMIDIFY, fill the water tank to the top. Rotate the dial to Humidify mode. The Steamer will omit steam for 40 minutes, humidifying the environment. \n \nBox Contents: \n
    \n
  • 1x STYLPRO 4-in-1 Ionic Spa Facial Steamer
    • \n
  • 1x Measuring Cup
    • \n
  • 1x UK & EU Adapte
    • \n

short_description: Helps to reduce the appearance of wrinkles, age spots, and uneven-looking skin, the STYLPRO™ Fabulous Firmer Neck & Face Smoother uses a combination of heat, vibrations, and LED light technology to help skin look firmer and more elastic, helping pores look tighter and help skin look clearer. Take control of your skincare journey and experience the benefits of pro-inspired sessions in the convenience of your own home. Cosmetic device. Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease

How to use

\nDevice movement: \nWhen using the device on your face and neck, we recommend these movements: \n1. From the chin upwards towards your outer cheek \n2. From the upper cheek upwards around your temples \n3. From the bottom of your neck upwards towards your chin \n4. From the bottom of your forehead towards your hairline \n \nBrighten mode: \n1. Hold down the power button for 1 second to turn on the device and enter the BRIGHTEN mode. \n2.Apply moisturiser, serum, or lotion to the skin, massage until fully absorbed. \n3.Ensure your fingers are touching the silver strip around the handle or the silver ring around the neck to enable the touch sensor. \n4.The device will begin vibrating once the tip touches your skin. \n5.Glide the massage head along your face and neck for at least 3 minutes. \n \nRenew mode: \n1.Hold down the power button for 1 second to turn the device on, then quickly press the power button ONCE to enter the RENEW mode. \n2.Apply moisturiser, serum, or lotion to the skin, massage until fully absorbed. \n3.Ensure your fingers are touching the silver strip around the handle or the silver ring around the neck to enable the touch sensor. \n4.The device will begin vibrating once the tip touches your skin. \n5.Glide the massage head along your face and neck for at least 2 minutes. \n \nRestore mode: \n1.Hold down the power button for 1 second to turn the device on, then quickly press the power button TWICE to enter the RESTORE mode. \n2.Apply moisturiser, serum, or lotion to the skin while you wait for the device to heat up. name: StylPro Smooth Finish
short_description: Turn your skincare routine into a self-care ritual with the StylPro Smooth Finish. Utilising ultrasonic vibrations and ionic technology, the facial enhancer works to cleanse, exfoliate and moisturise the skin to promote a clearer-looking complexion.
description:
Benifits: \n \nTurn your skincare routine into a self-care ritual with the StylPro Smooth Finish. Utilising ultrasonic vibrations and ionic technology, the facial enhancer works to cleanse, exfoliate and moisturise the skin to promote a clearer-looking complexion. \n \nOn the ‘cleanse’ setting, the ultrasonic vibrations work with your favourite cleanser to help remove impurities, loosen dead skin cells and unclog pores. When used with serums or moisturisers, the ‘moisturise’ setting helps to effectively work the product into the skin, whilst increasing absorption and enhancing the performance of your skincare products. \n \nThe device provides both negative or positive ions for both the ‘cleanse’ and ‘moisturise’ settings. Positive ions help to attract negatively charged impurities in the skin to promote a more refined and detoxified finish, while negative ions bond with any positive ions on your skin, helping to replenish moisture for long-lasting hydration. Skin is left feeling silky smooth and nourished, while adorned with a visibly lifted, more toned appearance. \n \nSet Contents: \n
    \n
  • STYLPRO Smooth Finish
    • \n
  • Rubber Cover
    • \n

Setting up your Smooth Finish: Ensure your Smooth Finish is fully charged with the USB charging cable. Turn it ‘ON’ using the button in the centre of the controls.
How to cleanse: Click the CLEANSE setting. Apply skin with preferred cleanser or balm. Lift the Smooth Finish to your face with the buttons facing you, then position the tool at a 45º angle. For a more detailed guide, check the instruction leaflet in your Smooth Finish box. Slowly push the tool forwards along your skin without stopping. For best results, use the ‘+’ button to release positive ions whilst cleansing, which will help to extract impurities from your skin.
How to moisturise: Click the MOISTURISE setting. Apply your favourite moisturiser or serum to your face. Lift the Smooth Finish to your face and turn it so the buttons are facing away from you, place the metal tip flat on your face, and glide the device backwards, slowly pushing the product into your skin. For best results, use the ‘-’ button to release negative ions, which helps your skin to further absorb moisture from your beauty products.

custom_tabs.content:
FAQs About medicube AGE-R Booster Pro:
  • Is the medicube AGE-R Booster really comparable to microneedling? The medicube AGE-R Booster Pro’s Air Shot mode is designed to mimic the effects of microneedling – but without any needles. It uses electrical pulses to create micro-channels in the skin, which help exfoliate, improve pore elasticity and smooth skin texture. While microneedling can lead to more dramatic results, the aesthetic procedure has to be done at a skin clinic, and it comes with side effects like redness and swelling immediately after treatment. The Booster Pro’s Air Shot setting offers a gentler, low-maintenance alternative to microneedling that can be done anytime in the comfort of your home.
  • Is medicube Booster Age-R Pro really worth the money? It sure is! Instead of buying separate gadgets for each skin concern, you get a multitasking powerhouse featuring six technologies in one compact device. It's easy to use, even for beginners, and many users see visible results in as little as three weeks.
  • When do you get used to the medicube Age-R Booster? It depends on your skin’s sensitivity and your comfort level with the device. Some people adjust to the vibrations right away, while others may need a few uses to feel fully comfortable. To ease into it, start with the lowest setting and gradually increase the intensity as your skin gets used to the sensation.

custom_tabs.title: Safety Information
custom_tabs.content:
Do not use the Shark CryoGlow Mask if you are taking:
  • Medication or supplements that cause sensitivity to light (photosensitivity), for example, medications for severe inflammatory acne (i.e. isotretinoin or doxycycline). Immediately stop using the device if you experience any discomfort. Do not use the Shark CryoGlow Mask if you have any of the following medical conditions:
  • Retinal and/or macular disease, ocular albinism, or any eye condition that causes sensitivity to light
  • Pregnant, nursing, or maybe pregnant
  • Pacemaker or another electronic implanted device
  • Implants in the face
  • Lack of sensation (e.g., numbness)
  • Light sensitive skin disorder (e.g., lupus, porphyria)
  • Extreme light sensitivity of the eyes (i.e., photophobia)
  • Light-induced headaches
  • Albinism
  • Melasma (i.e., condition that causes patches and spots)
  • Sensitivity or allergy to plastic, aluminium, or self-fastening material. Do not use the Shark CryoGlow Mask if you have any of the following conditions on the face, hairline, ears, or neck:
  • Recent facial surgery (until you have been cleared by your doctor)
  • Suspicious lesions or skin cancer
  • Eczema
  • Psoriasis
  • Irregularly shaped, new, or changing brown spots
  • Birthmarks
  • Broken skin, skin rash, or blisters
  • Tissue inflammation
  • Skin infection, cold sore, or warts
  • Active current outbreak of herpes simplex virus (cold sores)
  • History of herpes outbreaks without receiving preventative treatment
  • Facial treatment where the skin has not fully healed, including neurotoxin, dermal filler, micro needling, laser, or chemical peel Do not apply Shark CryoGlow Mask’s cooling routines on the eyeball or upper eyelid. Do not use the Shark CryoGlow Mask’s cooling routines if you have any of the following medical conditions:
  • Cold hypersensitivity
  • Cold urticaria (i.e., hives brought on by cold temperatures)
  • Circulatory insufficiency PRECAUTIONS: Consult a medical professional before using the Shark CryoGlow Mask if you:
  • Have bruising on the face.
  • Are experiencing skin sensitivity or irritation with retinol or benzoyl peroxide.
